PLAN "2-Week Travel Maintenance — Bodyweight & Pull-up Bar"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "maintain muscle and strength during travel"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Upper Pull & Core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 30m "Lower Body & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          single_leg_glute_bridge 2x10..12 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..25 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Upper Push & Shoulders":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Pull Emphasis & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x30..45 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Full Body Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
      DAY Saturday training 20m "Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hollow_hold 3x20..40 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 5m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5x1..2 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Upper Pull & Core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 30m "Lower Body & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          single_leg_glute_bridge 2x10..12 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..25 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Upper Push & Shoulders":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Pull & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x30..45 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Full Body Maintenance":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..40 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
      DAY Saturday training 20m "Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 5m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5x1..2 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m

goals.name: maintain muscle and strength during travel
